page_title: GET 0-1 MAL | Getafe v Mallorca 21/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Jose Munuera is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
90+2' A rebound sits up nicely for Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) and he needs no second invitation to shoot from distance. The effort, however, balloons high over the bar and out for a goal kick.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
88' Dominik Greif pulls off a fantastic save! Christantus Uche (Getafe) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the left post, but the effort is kept out.
87' Here comes a substitution. Cyle Larin is given a rest as he is replaced by Abdon Prats (Mallorca).
87' Jagoba Arrasate decides to make a substitution. Antonio Sanchez will be replaced by Valery (Mallorca).
87' Jose Munuera shows a yellow card to Robert Navarro (Mallorca) for his blatant foul.
86' Great teamplay by Getafe as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
83' The game is interrupted. Carles Perez (Getafe) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
82' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
80' Juan Berrocal Gonzalez (Getafe) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
79' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Diego Rico (Getafe) was quite harsh and Jose Munuera didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
78' Here is a change. Daniel Rodriguez is going off and Jagoba Arrasate gives the last tactical orders to Jose Copete (Mallorca).
76' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
74' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Mallorca.
71' Carles Perez (Getafe) picks up a pass and unleashes a low shot towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Dominik Greif.
69' The substitution is prepared. Robert Navarro (Mallorca) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Takuma Asano.
68' Dangerous play by Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe). Jose Munuera blows his whistle for a foul.

68' Poor effort! The corner picks out Juan Berrocal Gonzalez (Getafe) completely unmarked in the centre of the box. He has time to pick his spot with the header but makes a mess of it, sending the ball well wide of the left post.
67' Luis Milla (Getafe) prepares to take a corner kick.
67' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball goes out of play. Getafe are awarded a corner kick.
65' Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) is able to continue to play.
64' Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) picks up an injury.
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Coba Gomez da Costa departs the field of play to be replaced by Alvaro Rodriguez (Getafe).
63' Christantus Uche (Getafe) turns on the edge of the box and immediately fires in a shot at goal, but the keeper can relax as it spins well wide of the left post.
61' Juan Berrocal Gonzalez (Getafe) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Jose Munuera saw the whole situation.
59' The referee is firm and issues Dominik Greif (Mallorca) a deserved yellow card.
59' What a wasted chance that was! A precise cross into the box finds Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe), whose header flies narrowly wide of the right post.
58' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
57' Mallorca are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
53' Jose Bordalas Jimenez is forced to make a change. Allan Nyom is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Carles Perez (Getafe).
53' 0 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Cyle Larin (Mallorca) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper David Soria no chance!
53' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) is going to take the penalty!
52' Referee Jose Munuera is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Mallorca!
52' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Mallorca as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.
51' Juan Berrocal Gonzalez (Getafe) makes a slide tackle, but referee Jose Munuera blows for a foul. A penalty is given to Mallorca!
50' The attendance for today's match is 9747.
49' Allan Nyom (Getafe) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
48' The Getafe players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
48' Getafe can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
46' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Juan Berrocal Gonzalez comes on the pitch for Djene (Getafe).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+1' The match has reached half-time.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' Christantus Uche (Getafe) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
45' Takuma Asano (Mallorca) is flagged offside and it's not the first time today.
42' Coba Gomez da Costa (Getafe) stretches for the rebound inside the box, but can only send it high over the bar.
42' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Luis Milla (Getafe), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
41' Martin Valjent (Mallorca) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Getafe have a free kick.
40' Christantus Uche (Getafe) commits a foul and Jose Munuera immediately signals a free kick.
39' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
37' The foul by Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) was seen by Jose Munuera who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
36' We are about to witness a substitution. Peter Federico (Getafe) is replacing Bertug Yildirim.
35' Good movement by Diego Rico (Getafe), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
33' Bertug Yildirim (Getafe) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
33' Takuma Asano (Mallorca) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
30' Coba Gomez da Costa (Getafe) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Dominik Greif intercepts the ball.
28' The flag is raised and Bertug Yildirim (Getafe) is offside again, not for the first time today.
27' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Coba Gomez da Costa (Getafe) but poses no threat.
25' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
24' David Soria pulls off a great save to deny Takuma Asano (Mallorca) who, makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive towards the middle of the goal.
23' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) leans back and sends a volley soaring over the bar from inside the box.
23' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
22' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
21' Djene (Getafe) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
21' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
20' Jose Munuera blows his whistle as Christantus Uche (Getafe) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
19' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Christantus Uche (Getafe) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.

18' Bertug Yildirim (Getafe) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the middle of the net is denied by Dominik Greif. This effort really didn't trouble him.
16' Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jose Munuera had an easy-decision to make.
15' Mallorca control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
12' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well wide of the left post.

11' Luis Milla (Getafe) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
10' Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) commits a rough challenge and Jose Munuera blows his whistle for a foul.
10' Takuma Asano (Mallorca) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
8' Flag up against Sergi Darder (Mallorca). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.

7' Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
6' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Bertug Yildirim (Getafe) heads on.
6' Getafe take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

5' Bertug Yildirim (Getafe) makes contact with a cross but fails to connect perfectly. His low drive heads straight towards the middle of the goal where the goalkeeper makes a decent save to deny him. Getafe will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
3' Bertug Yildirim (Getafe) is penalised for holding. Jose Munuera signals a set piece.
2' Christantus Uche (Getafe) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Mallorca will take the kick-off.
Jose Munuera was nominated as the referee for this game.
